channel.title: Claude AI Daily Brief
channel.description: Daily intelligence report on Claude AI news, Anthropic announcements, developer updates, and community buzz.

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — June 10, 2026
item.description:
1. Claude Fable 5 Goes Public — Anthropic released its first publicly available Mythos-class model, with always-on thinking and a 1M-token context window — days after warning that AI is getting too dangerous.

2. 80.3% on SWE-Bench Pro — Fable 5 lands ~21 points ahead of GPT-5.5 on the hardest coding benchmark, at $10/$50 per million tokens — free on paid plans through June 22, then usage credits.

3. Mythos 5 Stays Locked Down — The same model without safety classifiers is restricted to Glasswing partners and vetted researchers, while Fable 5 hit Amazon Bedrock, Cursor, and Copilot on day one.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — June 9, 2026
item.description:
1. LG Group Goes All-In on Claude Enterprise — LG CNS signed an integrated agreement to roll Claude Enterprise out across all LG Group affiliates, one of Anthropic's biggest Korea wins just after it opened a Seoul subsidiary.

2. Claude Lands Inside Apple's Foundation Models Framework — A new Anthropic Swift package implements Apple's LanguageModel protocol, letting iOS 27 apps route to Claude by changing a single dependency — no session-logic rewrite.

3. Enterprise Admin Roles Ship as a Retirement Clock Starts — Custom roles can now grant billing and privacy admin without Owner access, while Opus 4.1 is scheduled to retire on the API Aug 5 and the June 15 cutover sits 6 days out.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — June 8, 2026
item.description:
1. "When AI Builds Itself" — Anthropic Asks for a Pause Button — A new Anthropic Institute paper says Claude now writes 80%+ of its own merged code and maps the path to recursive self-improvement, calling for a verifiable global mechanism to slow or pause frontier development.

2. Doubled Limits, Backed by SpaceX Compute — Claude Code's 5-hour limits doubled and Opus API limits jumped sharply, underwritten by a SpaceX deal for the Colossus 1 data center — 300+ MW and 220,000+ GPUs coming online within the month.

3. Project Glasswing Scales to ~150 Orgs — Anthropic extended its critical-software security program to roughly 150 organizations across 15+ countries, while the new Claude Security product has patched 2,100+ vulnerabilities in three weeks.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — June 7, 2026
item.description:
1. Connector Directory Crosses 418 Integrations — MCP Goes Mainstream — With Strava and Abacor live as of June 1, Claude's verified-connector directory now tops 418 integrations across 30 categories. The same connectors that power chats now run inside Managed Agents — the ecosystem is the moat.

2. Code w/ Claude Tokyo Is 3 Days Out — In-person applications are closed; the livestream is open. After a week of version pinning, fallbackModel, and cross-session security fixes, the "What's new in Claude Code" talk has all the material it needs.

3. The IPO Math Gets Real — $965B Round, $47B Run-Rate — With the confidential S-1 in SEC review, the numbers underneath it are out: a $65B Series H at a $965B valuation, a run-rate past $47B, and a reported $1.75–1.8T IPO target.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — June 6, 2026
item.description:
1. Claude Code Ships a fallbackModel Setting — Resilience, Productized — v2.1.166 lets you configure up to three fallback models that kick in when the primary is overloaded or unavailable. Four days after a sub-agent outage froze fleets, "what if the model is down" now has a one-line answer in settings.

2. Outage Post-Mortem Still Pending — Day Four — Anthropic still hasn't published a root-cause analysis for the June 2 sub-agent runaway, and the follow-on Claude Code incident from June 3 lingered. The silence is now the story, with Code w/ Claude Tokyo four days out.

3. Mythos Public Release Nears as Safeguards Land — Anthropic reiterates Mythos-class models are coming "in the coming weeks," with the safeguard work already shipped inside Opus 4.8. The gate is cyber-misuse prevention, not capability.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — June 5, 2026
item.description:
1. Claude Code Ships Enterprise Version Pinning — Thursday's v2.1 release adds requiredMinimumVersion and requiredMaximumVersion managed settings: Claude Code now refuses to start outside an admin-approved version range. Three days after a sub-agent bug took down the platform, admins get fleet-level control over exactly which build runs.

2. Fitch Puts Financial Advice in AI's Crosshairs — Bloomberg reports a Fitch Ratings warning that personal financial advisory risks "being fully substituted by AI solutions" if customers learn to trust non-human agents. Claude and ChatGPT are named as the tools leading the charge into a regulated, trust-based profession.

3. Outage Post-Mortem Still Pending, Three Days On — Anthropic has yet to publish a root-cause analysis for Tuesday's sub-agent runaway outage. Quota resets landed for affected Pro and Max users; the written explanation hasn't — and Code w/ Claude Tokyo is five days out.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — June 4, 2026
item.description:
1. Claude Partner Network Gets a Services Track and Partner Hub — Anthropic formalized its $100M partner program with a three-tier Services Track (Select, Preferred, Global Premier) and a Partner Hub portal where customers find qualified firms. 40,000+ firms have applied since March; 10,000+ consultants hold Claude certifications.

2. Comscore: Claude Desktop Conversations Up 1,858% to 22M — The Q1 2026 AI Intelligence Report puts Claude at 22M desktop conversations in March, up 1,858% since October. ChatGPT still leads at 244M, but Claude is the breakout growth story — third-party consumer data landing exactly when the S-1 needs it.

3. Anthropic Promises Mythos-Class Models for All Customers "In the Coming Weeks" — The Glasswing expansion to ~150 new organizations came with a bigger commitment: Mythos-class capability ships publicly once stronger cyber safeguards land. Partners have already found 10,000+ high- or critical-severity flaws.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — June 3, 2026
item.description:
1. Strava MCP Connector Goes Live — Claude Gets Native Access to Years of Activity Data — Strava began phased rollout of an MCP connector for paying subscribers, exposing per-second heart-rate, GPS, power, and pace streams to Claude via OAuth read-only auth. The first mass-consumer MCP integration of the year.

2. Claude Code v2.1.160 Locks Down Shell-Startup and Build-Tool Writes — The Tuesday release adds explicit prompts before any write to .zshenv, .bash_login, ~/.config/git/, .npmrc, bunfig.toml, devcontainer files and similar paths — closing the most common acceptEdits-mode arbitrary-execution gotcha.

3. SAP Names Claude Its Primary Reasoning Model for SAP Business AI Platform — SAP and Anthropic are embedding Claude as the lead agentic capability across SAP's newly announced Business AI Platform — the deepest single-vendor enterprise integration since the PwC alliance expanded last week.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — June 2, 2026
item.description:
1. Anthropic Files Confidentially for IPO — The $1T Public-Market Test Is On — A draft S-1 went to the SEC Monday, less than a week after the $65B Series H closed at a $965B valuation. Anthropic leapfrogs OpenAI to the IPO door first, with $47B run-rate and an explicit late-2026 listing window.

2. Tuesday Outage Traced to a Runaway Claude Code Sub-Agent — A second hours-long outage in four days hit Claude, Console, API, and Claude Code starting around 2:10am ET. Root cause reportedly: Claude Code sub-agents multiplying excessively and burning user quotas. Emergency quota reset followed.

3. ENISA Becomes First EU Agency to Get Mythos Access — The EU's cybersecurity body joins Project Glasswing — the first time Mythos has been offered outside the US/UK. The bloc had to clear access with Washington. The dual-use model just became a geopolitical asset.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — June 1, 2026
item.description:
1. Post-Mortem Watch: Monday Opens With Outage Questions Unanswered — Anthropic still hasn't issued a public write-up of Saturday's hours-long Claude outage. With Salesforce, BMS, PwC, KPMG, and Thomson Reuters all running production workloads on Claude, the post-mortem is the first real test of the company's SLA posture as a $965B enterprise platform.

2. Code w/ Claude Tokyo Is Nine Days Out — Anthropic's Biggest Asia Push Yet — June 10–11 in Tokyo with simultaneous English-Japanese interpretation, livestream, an Extended day for independent devs, and keynotes from Ami Vora, Boris Cherny, and Angela Jiang.

3. Colossus 1 Capacity Ramps Up — 220K+ GPUs, $1.25B/Month — The all-of-Colossus-1 deal Anthropic signed with xAI is now actively absorbing inference load. 300MW+, 220,000+ Nvidia GPUs (H100, H200, GB200), capped at 11% of the broader xAI park. The reliability story for H2 2026 runs through Memphis.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — May 31, 2026
item.description:
1. Saturday Outage Hits Claude Users Worldwide — A multi-hour disruption that began Saturday afternoon ET left users globally unable to load conversations or get responses. Anthropic's status page logged "Opus 4.7 elevated errors" resolved late Saturday night. The outage landed two days after the $65B Series H closed.

2. The $1T IPO Drumbeat Gets Louder — Motley Fool, Yahoo Finance, and CNBC all ran "next $1T IPO" takes on Anthropic over the weekend. $965B private mark, $47B run-rate (up from $30B in April, $9B last year), and a reported late-2026 IPO target.

3. Auto Mode Lands on Bedrock, Vertex, and Microsoft Foundry — Friday's Claude Code release made Auto Mode available across all three major cloud platforms for Opus 4.7 and 4.8. Multi-cloud parity is now the platform norm, not a roadmap item.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — May 30, 2026
item.description:
1. Mythos-Class Models Head for Public Release "in the Coming Weeks" — Anthropic confirmed Mythos-class models are coming to all customers in the coming weeks. The system that found 10,000+ zero-days via Project Glasswing is leaving its restricted defensive-consortium box, with a June rollout in stages expected.

2. Claude Overtakes OpenAI in Enterprise — Salesforce Will Spend ~$300M on Tokens — Ramp's May 2026 AI Index puts Claude at 34.4% of business adoption vs OpenAI's 32.3%. Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff confirmed a ~$300M Anthropic token commitment for 2026, mostly on coding.

3. Claude Code Is Now ~4% of All Public GitHub Commits — Wiz migrated 50,000 lines of Python to Go in 20 hours of active development with Claude Code, work originally scoped at 2-3 months. Dynamic Workflows in Opus 4.8 doing the heavy lifting.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — May 29, 2026
item.description:
1. Anthropic Closes $65B Series H at a $965B Valuation — Altimeter, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, and Sequoia led, with Samsung, SK Hynix, and Micron joining as strategic infrastructure partners. Anthropic is now the world's most valuable startup, past OpenAI, with run-rate revenue reportedly past $47B.

2. Claude Opus 4.8 Ships with Dynamic Workflows and a 69.2% SWE-Bench Pro — Opus 4.8 beats Opus 4.7 (64.3%), GPT-5.5 (58.6%), and Gemini 3.1 Pro (54.2%) on agentic coding. Fast Mode runs 2.5x faster at the same price.

3. Anthropic Acquires Stainless to Own SDK and MCP Server Tooling — Hundreds of API providers use Stainless to ship libraries, CLIs, and MCP servers. Bringing it in-house tightens the supply chain from Claude model to agent connector.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — May 28, 2026
item.description:
1. SAP Puts Claude at the Center of Business AI Platform — At SAP Sapphire, SAP and Anthropic expanded their partnership. Claude becomes the primary reasoning and agentic engine embedded across SAP's AI-enabled portfolio, powering the newly announced SAP Business AI Platform.

2. 28 New Security and Compliance Integrations Land for Claude — Anthropic shipped integrations across DLP, SASE, SIEM, identity, eDiscovery, AI security posture management, and observability so IT and security teams can govern Claude inside the stacks they already run.

3. Bristol Myers Squibb Goes All-In on Claude Enterprise — BMS signed a strategic agreement to position Claude Enterprise as its shared intelligence platform across research, clinical development, manufacturing, commercial, and corporate functions.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — May 27, 2026
item.description:
1. Anthropic Puts Claude Agents on a Meter — Starting June 15, programmatic usage (Agent SDK, claude -p, Code GitHub Actions, third-party apps) draws from a separate monthly credit pool billed at full API rates — $20 Pro, $100 Max 5x, $200 Max 20x, no rollover.

2. Managed Agents Gain Dreaming and Multiagent Orchestration — Claude Managed Agents picked up Dreaming, multiagent orchestration, outcomes, and webhooks; MCP tunnels hit research preview and self-hosted sandboxes opened in public beta.

3. Thomson Reuters Wires Claude Into CoCounsel — An expanded partnership connects Claude directly to CoCounsel Legal via MCP, the latest piece of Anthropic’s fast-growing legal stack of 20+ connectors and 12 practice-area plugins.

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — May 26, 2026
item.description:
1. Mythos Heads for Claude Code and Claude Security — Anthropic's restricted, cyber-capable Mythos model surfaced in public Claude Code references and is being lined up for a gated rollout — a reversal from the earlier "no public release" line.

2. Project Glasswing's First Report: 10,000+ Critical Bugs — Roughly 50 partners, including Microsoft, Apple, Google, and Cloudflare, used Claude Mythos Preview to find more than 10,000 high- or critical-severity vulnerabilities in one month.

3. Claude Security Hits Public Beta — Built on Opus 4.7, the scanner has already helped patch more than 2,100 corporate vulnerabilities by reading codebases, triaging findings, and writing fixes.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — May 25, 2026
item.description:
1. SAP Puts Claude at the Center of Its "Autonomous Enterprise" — At Sapphire, SAP named Claude a primary reasoning engine for its Business AI Platform, wiring it through MCP into 224 agents across S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, and Ariba.

2. Security Vendors Pile Into the Compliance API — Netskope, SailPoint, Proofpoint, CrowdStrike, and Cloudflare all shipped integrations that pull Claude prompts and activity logs into the DLP, SIEM, and identity tools enterprises already run.

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — May 24, 2026
item.description:
1. Anthropic Reportedly Raising $30B+ at a $900B+ Valuation — The company is said to be in early talks for a round of at least $30 billion at a pre-money valuation north of $900 billion, the fuel behind a breakneck two weeks.

2. A $100M Claude Partner Network and a $200M Gates Foundation Deal — Anthropic is putting capital behind distribution: funding partners that deploy Claude in big orgs, plus grants and credits for health, life sciences, and education.

3. Claude for Legal Goes All-In — 20+ MCP connectors and 12 practice-area plugins; Thomson Reuters and the Free Law Project wired data into Claude over MCP, with BigLaw firms running Cowork on live matters.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — May 23, 2026
item.description:
1. KPMG Puts Claude in Front of 276,000 Staff — A global alliance gives every KPMG employee across 138 countries access to Claude and embeds it in Digital Gateway, the platform its clients use to do real work.

2. Anthropic Silently Patches a 5-Month Claude Code Sandbox Bypass — A SOCKS5 null-byte trick let sandboxed code defeat any wildcard allowlist and exfiltrate credentials, fixed in v2.1.90 with no CVE and no security note.

3. Coros Becomes the First Wearable to Ship an Official MCP Server — Authorize once and Claude can read your workouts, sleep, HRV, and race readiness — MCP leaking out of the dev world and into consumer hardware.

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — May 22, 2026
item.description:
1. Code with Claude Ships Managed Agents — Multiagent Orchestration delegates work to parallel specialist agents, Outcomes lets you define success criteria to iterate against, and Dreaming lets Claude recall and build on past sessions.

2. Self-Hosted Sandboxes + MCP Tunnels — Run agents on your own infrastructure and let them reach internal systems without touching the public internet — the plumbing that unblocks enterprise pilots.

3. Claude Design Debuts From Anthropic Labs — A new tool to collaborate with Claude on designs, prototypes, slides, and one-pagers, pushing Claude into the visual-output layer.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — May 21, 2026
item.description:

2. SAP Makes Claude Its Primary Reasoning Engine — At SAP Sapphire, Anthropic's models get embedded across the new SAP Business AI Platform, putting Claude inside the enterprise system of record for finance, supply chain, and HR workflows.

3. Cache Diagnostics + Fast Mode for Opus 4.7 — The Claude Developer Platform ships cache diagnostics in public beta to explain prompt-cache misses, and extends fast mode to Opus 4.7 with up to 2.5x higher output tokens per second.

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — May 20, 2026
item.description:
1. Code with Claude London Keynote Day — Day-1 livestreams today across three tracks (Research, Claude Platform, Claude Code), with an Extended edition for indie devs and founders. This year's tour is about agent infrastructure, not a new model.

2. Anthropic Acquires Stainless — the SDK and MCP startup behind every official Claude library, in a deal reported above $300M. The team folds into Claude Platform and Stainless winds down its hosted SDK generator; existing customers keep the right to modify code they've already generated.

3. KPMG Signs a Global Claude Alliance — Claude goes into Digital Gateway across 276,000 staff, starting with tax and PE clients, and Anthropic is named a preferred private-equity partner to co-build products for portfolio companies.

item.description:

Interactive pool (Claude.ai, Claude Code in terminal, Cowork) is unchanged. Claim email lands around June 8. Every team running unattended Claude Code or SDK workloads on a Pro or Max subscription needs to rerun the budget today.

First status incident on the newer Opus 4.7 tier in the recent six-event May streak. Migration call still stands on the broader pattern but the "clean tier" framing now has a counterexample 36 hours before London Extended.

Sonnet 4.8 Watch T-Minus 24 Hours to London Extended May 20 — EPAM 10,000-Architect Alliance Lands as the Tuesday Demand-Side Stamp — Anthropic landed the billing post on Tuesday rather than the model post. Deliberate sequencing — billing today, model and platform tomorrow. Wednesday keynote carries the Sonnet 4.8 story alone on a cleaner cycle.

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — May 16, 2026
item.description:
1. Benioff Names the Salesforce 2026 Anthropic Spend at Roughly $300M for Coding and Product Work and Previews a Slack-Embedded Coding Surface with Claude Underneath — the Demand-Side Bookend on the Five-Anchor Week — Marc Benioff on the All-In podcast puts the dollar figure on the record and previews a new Slack-native coding tool that uses Claude as the underlying model. The named spend gives the agentic-coding category its single largest publicly disclosed customer commitment to date.

2. Anthropic Publishes a Postmortem Tracing Six Weeks of Claude Code Quality Complaints to Three Overlapping Product Changes — Load-Balancer Routing, Default Effort Level, and Context-Cache TTL Combined to Degrade Output Quality in Subtle, Hard-to-Reproduce Ways — The InfoQ-relayed write-up names three concurrent changes that interacted to produce the late-March-through-early-May "Claude got dumber" discourse. Reversion on all three is the working fix. The transparency cadence is starting to look deliberate.

3. Friday's May 15 Elevated-Error Window Logged Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 Dragging the Recovery Curve While Opus 4.7 Returned to Normal First — the Model-Tier Divergence Is the Operational Read of the Weekend, and Sonnet 4.8 Watch Is Now T-Minus 4 Business Days to London Extended May 20 — Third recent incident with the same recovery-curve pattern. The migration call to production teams is direct: move off Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 before the May 20 Sonnet 4.8 paired-drop.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — May 15, 2026
item.description:
1. PwC Expands the Anthropic Alliance — 30,000 US Employees Will Be Claude-Code-Certified and the Full 364,000 Global Workforce Gets Claude Code; the Three-Pillar Frame Is Build, Deal, and Reinvent — The Big Four consultancy commits to a workforce-scale Claude rollout across three named pillars: building agentic tools for clients, deploying AI across the dealmaking process, and reinventing client operating models. The consulting-services scaffolding underneath the SAP / Legal / SMB demand-anchor wave.

2. Anthropic and the Gates Foundation Forge a $200M Four-Year Partnership — Grant Funding, Claude Usage Credits, and Technical Support Across Global Health, Life Sciences, Education, and Economic Mobility — The mission-side stamp of the cycle. The four-year package combines philanthropic grant funding with credits against Claude usage and technical support for grantees, with named program areas spanning global health and life-science research, education, and economic mobility. The public-benefit counterpart to Thursday's Pentagon IL6/IL7 exclusion.

3. Third-Party Agent Credit-Meter Discourse Settles Into the Second Day — Developer Cohort Splits Between Accept-and-Rerun-the-Numbers and Switch-the-Runner — Twenty-four hours into the policy reinstatement, the discourse hardens into two camps. The cleanest landing for Anthropic is a formal pricing-page update with the plan-by-plan credit breakdown and an explainer of overflow at API token rates.

Read full report →

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — May 14, 2026
item.description:
1. Claude for Small Business Launches — 15 Ready-Run Agentic Workflows Across Intuit QuickBooks, PayPal, HubSpot, Canva, Docusign, Google Workspace, and Microsoft 365; a 10-City Free AI Fluency Tour Kicks Off Today in Chicago — Anthropic stamps the third demand-side anchor of the week: a packaged toggle-install for the SMB seat with 100 SMB leaders per stop across Chicago, Tulsa, Dallas, New Jersey, Baton Rouge, Birmingham, Salt Lake City, Baltimore, San Jose, and Indianapolis. No extra charge above existing Claude licenses.

2. Third-Party Agent Tools Are Back on Paid Claude Plans — But Behind a Separate, Non-Rollover Monthly Credit Meter Worth $20–$200 by Plan, Billed at API Token Rates — Axios put it on the wire Thursday morning: programmatic and external-agent usage is reinstated but moves to a fixed plan-tied credit pool. The clearest read yet of where OpenAI agent-token competitive pressure lands on the Claude pricing page.

3. Pentagon Awards IL6/IL7 Classified-Network AI Contracts to Eight Big-Tech Vendors — Anthropic Deliberately Excluded Over Its Insistence on Warfare-Use Guardrails — The May 1 deals went to eight vendors with Anthropic shut out over its safety-guardrail position for AI in warfare. The S-1 risk-factor paragraph on government-revenue access now has a named federal-side data point alongside the EU access-track gap.

item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — May 13, 2026
item.description:

Claude for Legal Goes Live — 20+ MCP Connectors and 12 Practice-Area Plugins Ship; Thomson Reuters CoCounsel, Westlaw, Practical Law, Harvey, Everlaw, iManage, NetDocuments, Ironclad, DocuSign, Relativity, Box and Datasite Named, Freshfields the Co-Development Reference — A packaged legal offering built on Claude plus Cowork, surfaced inside Microsoft Word, Outlook, Excel, and PowerPoint with context carrying across all four. The twelve plugins cover commercial, corporate, employment, privacy, regulatory, AI governance, IP, and litigation work.

SAP Sapphire 2026 Names Claude the Primary Reasoning and Agentic Capability for the New SAP Business AI Platform — Joule Agents Now Route Through Claude Across S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, and Ariba via MCP — The expanded partnership lands inside the Tuesday Sapphire keynote alongside SAP's "Autonomous Enterprise" framing and the Nvidia/Palantir co-billing; custom agents for public sector, healthcare, education, life sciences, and utilities are on the roadmap.

Claude Code v2.1.140 Ships With Worktree baseRef Controls, Custom Sandbox Paths on Linux/WSL, Admin Policy Merge Options, and Effort Level Exposed to Hooks; Sonnet 4.8 Watch Slips Past the May 6-13 Corridor, London Extended May 20 Now the Working Frame — The governance-and-platform release after Monday's outcomes wave. item.title: Claude AI Daily Brief — May 12, 2026
item.description:

Lands inside the same window the Snyk Evo SAST layer, Project Glasswing, and the Cyber Verification Program are stitching together the company's public cybersecurity story.

The corporate-housekeeping shoe to drop inside the reported $50B round at a $900B target valuation with secondary-market pricing implying $1T.

Claude Code v2.1.139 Ships Monday Evening — Agent View, the /goal Command, Plugin Details with Per-Session Token Cost, and a Hook args[] Field for Shell-less Exec; Sonnet 4.8 Watch Day Seven of Seven — v2.1.139 lands at 18:43 Monday with fifty changes. Headline items: the agent view (Research Preview) and the /goal command.
